_meta.description: Rules for classifying discrepancies between LLM outputs as tolerated (within acceptable variation) or material (hard failure requiring review). These rules define what 'agreement' means for each field type.

always_tolerated.description: These field types never trigger hard failures regardless of disagreement magnitude
always_tolerated.rationale: Text fields, subjective categorizations, and event lists vary legitimately between models. The core numeric extraction is what matters for the research dataset.

always_tolerated_suffixes.description: Fields containing these substrings are always tolerated
always_tolerated_suffixes.rationale: Page numbers differ by PDF viewer indexing. Confidence scores are model-internal assessments.

numeric_tolerance.description: Two numeric values are considered equivalent if within these bounds
numeric_tolerance.absolute_tolerance_description: 0.05 absolute difference (catches near-zero rounding e.g. -0.01 vs -0.011)
numeric_tolerance.null_zero_description: null/None and 0.0 are treated as equivalent (both mean 'not found / not applicable')

list_of_dicts_tolerance.description: Rules for comparing structured lists (gross_premium_mix, lob_movements)
list_of_dicts_tolerance.zero_description: Entries with amount < 0.01 and percentage < 0.01 are ignored (not meaningful)
list_of_dicts_tolerance.subtotal_description: Entries whose line_of_business starts with 'Total' or 'Sub-total' are ignored (these are subtotal rows, not individual LOBs)

material_fields.description: These fields trigger hard failures if they disagree beyond tolerance
material_fields.gross_premium_mix_note: Non-zero, non-subtotal entries missing from one model or with amount differences beyond numeric tolerance are material
